description: This file is a shell test script for the 'git mktree' command, involving setting up a git repository, performing various operations, and testing the 'git mktree' functionality with different inputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites needed to run certain tests.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Updates the index with specified object info.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from the index.

methods.name: git ls-tree
methods.description: Lists the contents of a tree object.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Returns the object name of a reference.

methods.name: git mktree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from ls-tree output read from stdin.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for differences.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
